set.description: Arts centre in the Saadiyat Cultural District with changing exhibitions, free to enter. It also has an Art Studio running scheduled painting and drawing workshops, and a drop-in ceramics studio.

Arts centre next to Qasr Al Hosn with free exhibitions and talks. It also houses the Al Marsam Al Hor art studio, the Bait Al Khatt calligraphy studio and the Children's Art Centre, all with scheduled workshops.
